text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I was holding a meeting with Gold City today, but...

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry! Would it be alright
if I take City to a photoshoot right now!?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Mane-G?
I don't have any work today, so...

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, but this shoot is necessary!
They want pictures in your racewear for an Umamusume special feature.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
"This photoshoot will give the public a fresh impression of you.
So for your sake as well...!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Hey. Manager,
can I bring this little guy to the studio too?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
There'll be downtime while they adjust the equipment anyway.
We'll have our meeting then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, I ended up holding the meeting with Gold City
inside the photo studio.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Alright. The strategy's set.
All that's left is to run, huh.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Well, but first, we've got a photoshoot.

text_block_list.name: Stylist
text_block_list.text:
My, City-chan. That's a lovely racing outfit.
Is the jacket inspired by rider fashion?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ah. That's true.

text_block_list.name: Stylist
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, I knew it~.
So, tell us straight up: what's the concept behind your racing outfit?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, things I wanna try, I guess.
Anyway, I've got a shoot to get to.

text_block_list.name: Stylist
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you dodged the question.
Good luck today too~.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*.
choice_data_list: So what is it you want to try?
Is there something you want to try?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, asking that so bluntly?
Ever heard of tact?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: "...Part of it is inspired by motorcycles. Feeling the wind, like you could ride on forever."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—Back when I walked the runway,
there was this time I wore a biker outfit.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
To solidify the image for the walk,
I asked a staff member who loves motorcycles to teach me.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
When you ride a bike, you're totally exposed, right?
So the wind hits your face directly.
It hurts like crazy in the winter, and it's freezing cold.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Still, in exchange... it feels like I'm moving forward under my own power.
That's somehow kind of fun, I guess..."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's a two-wheeler, so if you don't put the kickstand down
or keep riding, it'll fall over.
choice_data_list: Have you ever ridden a motorcycle?
Have you ever ridden a motorcycle before?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...I didn't, it's just a model. I only asked the staff
what it feels like when you're riding one.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
To prevent accident risks, apparently?
Either way, it's prohibited in the contract.
choice_data_list: I can run even more amazingly than a motorcycle can ride, you know.
I can run even more impressively than a bike, you know!?
Then I'll give you a ride someday.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
To prevent accident risks, apparently?
Either way, it's prohibited in the contract.
choice_data_list: I can run even more amazingly than a motorcycle can ride, you know.
I can run even more impressively than a bike, you know!?
Then I'll give you a ride someday.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Idiot.
Who are you trying to impress?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Good grief. Snazzy words of encouragement
suit you least of anyone in the world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Soon after, Gold City was called by the photographer
and stepped up for the photoshoot.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
"Great work today!
Even the photographer had nothing but praise for you!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Still, give me a break with this stuff.
Even if you wanted to call me out, today was way too sudden.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I'm sorry.
But you really had such a wonderful expression.
It showed a whole new side of you, in a way...

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: Did something good happen before the shoot?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Before the photoshoot...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "I can run even more wonderfully than any motorcycle, after all."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "I can run even more wonderfully than a motorcycle, too."

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
There was one!? Could we incorporate that
into my pre-shoot routine in the future?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Maneji, you're overthinking things.
We've all got tomorrow ahead of us. Wrap it up, wrap it up!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she speaks, Gold City's cheeks
are tinged a little redder than usual.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you are? Haha...
What do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's start the photoshoot!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Okaaay.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, I'm running on the way back.
Just drop me off somewhere along the riverbank.
Thanks."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And on the way back to the academy after finishing the photoshoot—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (VRRRROOOOOOM!)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ――Ah. A motorcycle.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hey... about what we were talking about earlier.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...How seriously should I take this?
